contexts.text: In thought they can... range at large through the whole Heaven.
(Such) can walk about in the paradises...
To which their thoughts were wont to range.
When I suffered my ideas to range at large...
In order that those in the Society may be restrained from wandering about any further.
Although thought from the spirit ranges about outside of him...
He ranged about in the net... Concerning (this) ranging about...
They acted as if they were ranging about in an open field (of thought).
a. So with the thought, which can range into the universe...
They are tortured because they cannot wander forth from the body by the thoughts.
There is given to every Spirit the opportunity to go out of his own Society, and wander around; but they who love uses for the sake of uses never want to do it...
We may not as yet expatiate upon this subject.

The mind (then) has an extension into everything of the whole body, and ranges there through its forms, as the thoughts and affections of the Angels do into the Societies of the universal Heaven. AE 837:2, Explained. DLove 13:4.
If there were room to expatiate so far...
For spiritual thought can range into innumerable things into which natural thought cannot.
Works keep the lower mind as in... bonds, and prevent it from wandering into the ravings of these cupidities.
